newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Tuesday.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. May consumer confidence index and April existing homes sales figures.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on some position adjustments. Some people are waiting for tonight's release of the consumer confidence index and existing home sales figures, for more clues to market direction, but unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged from Monday's 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent.
